Tag mode

The outdoor game.

No secret word. The box tells each of you if you're crew or an imposter, then you play outside. Pick somewhere with things to hide behind.

Start a game

  1. 1
    Set it up Tap Tag. Pick players, imposters, and how many emergency meetings the group shares (0 to 9). Tap START.
  2. 2
    See your role Pass the box around. Each player holds the button to see CREW or IMPOSTER, then taps Next.
  3. 3
    Go play After the last player, the box shows the play screen. Keep it somewhere everyone can reach.

Tagging

Only imposters tag. If you're tagged, lie down right where you are. A player on the ground is a body.

Fake deaths

Anyone can lie down without being tagged, to bait or to confuse. Fakers get up at the end of the next meeting.

IMPOSTER
Tag them. Blend in.
HOLD
P3
Next

Role only, no word

Meetings

  • Body meeting: find a body, shout, and everyone gathers. Free, as many as you want.
  • Emergency meeting: call one any time, even with no body. These come from the shared count on the box.

Every meeting ends in a vote: point at once on three, most votes is out. Voting is the only way crew get imposters out.

End every meeting with "3, 2, 1, UP!"

Everyone lying down gets up together, so fakers don't stand out. Then no tagging for 15 seconds.

Out? You're a ghost

Once you're tagged or voted out, go quiet and step off the play area. Never say who tagged you.

The play screen

Left tile: emergency meetings left. Tap it to use one.
Right tile: the tag cooldown. Imposters tap it right after a tag and wait for zero before tagging again.
